text_block_list.text:
One day during training, Biwa<n>Hayahide seems
rather preoccupied<n>with her hand.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: No, it's fine. I just ran out of hand<n>cream.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I chose it specifically because the<n>ingredients are
perfect for my skin,<n>but there's a shortage right
now, so<n>my hands are rougher than usual.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
choice_data_list:
Why don't we look for some other hand cream for
you?

Why don't we look for some other hand cream for
you?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What? Oh no, I'm fine! I'm sure my<n>usual hand
cream will be back in<n>stock soon.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Er, this has nothing to do with my<n>running, so you
don't have to check<n>my hands or anything, right?

Biwa Hayahide seems rather<n>abashed by the
condition of her skin.
